The '''Industrial Spaceport''' was a series of docking clamps and [[Airlock/Legends|airlocks]] in the [[Industrial Levels]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] for ships too large for the [[Hangar/Legends|landing bays]] at [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]].
